name: Leadership
overview: Scripture emphasizes that godly leadership is founded on fear of God, truthfulness, and integrity, as seen in Exodus 18:21 where leaders are chosen for their character to govern justly. Effective leadership involves wise counsel, providing safety and guidance to the people (Proverbs 11:14). Jesus contrasts worldly authority with servant leadership, teaching that greatness in His kingdom is marked by humility and ministering to others rather than exercising dominion (Matthew 20:25-26; Mark 10:42). Conversely, bad leadership is condemned, particularly when pastors fail in their responsibility to care for the flock (Jeremiah 23:1). These verses collectively affirm that leadership, especially within the church and home, must reflect Christlike servanthood and moral integrity.
